verdict.rationale: turbopuffer documents approximate nearest-neighbor vector search: vectors are incrementally indexed in an SPFresh index, auto-tuned for 90-100% recall, with a recall endpoint for self-testing, and exact kNN is offered separately. Nothing in the evidence shows configurable distance metrics (e.g., cosine vs. Euclidean), so a named part of the story is unevidenced. missing for 10: documentation of configurable distance metrics, independent or hands-on corroboration of ANN quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run approximate nearest-neighbor similarity search over embeddings with configurable distance metrics

citations.quote: Vectors are incrementally indexed in an SPFresh vector index for performant search.
